add-tip-header: Add a tip for your driver
cars-bike-blurb: A single-rider e-bike: a frame, a saddle and two wheels, for a quick solo hop across town.
cars-black-blurb: An executive saloon with the longest bonnet in the fleet and the lowest roofline over it.
cars-comfort-blurb: A long-wheelbase saloon: low nose, a cabin set well back, and a real boot behind it.
cars-green-blurb: A one-box electric. With no engine bay to leave room for, the cabin starts at the nose.
cars-heli-blurb: A four-seat light helicopter — a glass pod, a tail boom, and the only member of the family that never touches the road.

cars-lede: Every vehicle RMH Rideshare dispatches, built from one shape. Each body is a glass shell with a wireframe stretched over it — the same material the site’s navigation globe is made of, told what to be. Turn one, poke it, and watch the wave cross it.
cars-lineup-note: Drawn at one scale, in metres, from the same measurements the 3D bodies are lofted from.
cars-stage-description: {{name}}, drawn as a glass wireframe on a turntable. {{blurb}}
cars-x-blurb: A five-door hatchback for up to four people — and the shape the rest of the family is drawn from.
cars-xl-blurb: A three-row people carrier with a squared-off tail — the tallest, widest body on the road fleet.
